title: Helm chart probes: liveness/readiness/startup timing fields render via hasKey so an explicit 0 is kept; the chart owns the httpGet request
answers: Why is my probe's initialDelaySeconds set to 0 missing from the rendered MLflow Deployment?
How do I disable the startup probe in the MLflow Helm chart?
Where are the health probe path and HTTPS scheme set when TLS is enabled in the chart?
body:
Path: charts/templates/deployment.yaml builds the livenessProbe, readinessProbe and startupProbe from the probes.{liveness,readiness,startup} values (enabled, initialDelaySeconds, periodSeconds, timeoutSeconds, failureThreshold); the shared body is rendered by charts/templates/_helpers.tpl:mlflow.probe.
Rule: The chart always generates the httpGet request itself (path from server.staticPrefix + /health, the dynamic named port, scheme HTTPS when tls.enabled); values only control enablement and timing. Emit each timing field with `{{- if hasKey .probe "<field>" }}`, not `with`, because `with` treats 0 as empty and silently drops it.
Symptom: An explicit initialDelaySeconds: 0 (the documented startup probe default) did not appear in the rendered Deployment, so the output disagreed with values.yaml and the README.
Constraints: Setting probes.<name>.enabled: false omits that whole probe block. The `with` idiom is fine for non-numeric fields where empty means unset; use hasKey wherever 0 is a valid value.
Applies: Helm chart probe rendering in charts/; applies when adding or changing probe fields or the mlflow.probe template.
